name: HIVE Yguazu data center campus
notes: Yguazu site in Alto Parana; DCD reported Phase II completion and 200MW local hydro power, while HIVE's own April 2025 release documents Phase 1 completion and energization. A further 100MW expansion toward 400MW was announced for 2026.

name: HIVE Yguazu 100MW expansion
notes: Planned additional 100MW expansion at the hydro-powered Yguazu data center, expected to start construction in early 2026 and commission in Q3 2026.

name: Penguin Hernandarias Mandu'Ara data center
notes: Penguin's official site describes renewable-powered high-performance data center infrastructure with 100MW live and 500MW pipeline; Baxtel locates the facility in Hernandarias Industrial Park, Alto Parana.

name: Marathon Digital Hernandarias bitcoin-mining data center
notes: Baxtel lists an operational Hernandarias facility next to Itaipu Dam, powered by renewable hydroelectric energy; local press reports Marathon as a major Penguin partner with investment in the Hernandarias plant.

name: BitCluster Ciudad del Este mining data center
notes: BitCluster's official site lists Paraguay, Ciudad del Este with 12MW power for mining hosting; Baxtel also tracks the Ciudad del Este facility as operational.

name: LINK Telecom Ciudad del Este data center
notes: Inflect lists LINK Telecom Ciudad del Este at Calle Boqueron, Ed. Penta, Piso 5 as a Paraguay data center location.

name: Itaipu Binational Right Bank energy data center
notes: Baxtel lists an Itaipu Binational data center block on the Paraguay Right Bank near Hernandarias; appears to be an internal/energy-sector facility rather than commercial colocation.

name: IPXON Asuncion data center
notes: IPXON's official Asuncion data-center service page describes redundant power/cooling, cross-connects, security, and remote smart hands; Data Center Map lists IPXON Asuncion 1 at Cecilio da Silva Lovera 1001.

name: UFINET Paraguay S.A. Asuncion data center
notes: Inflect lists UFINET Paraguay S.A. Asuncion at Federacion Rusa 1461 with colocation services and local network ecosystem; Ufinet's official Paraguay page confirms Asuncion presence and data center services.

name: X8 Cloud Paraguay AI data center
notes: Announced AI/cloud data center complex near Asuncion with initial 50MW commercial operations target and later 500MW expansion cited by Baxtel; exact municipality not publicly pinned, assigned to Asuncion metro.

name: Yguazu Digital Paraguay-Taiwan AI data center
developer: Yguazu Digital joint venture / Paraguay and Taiwan
notes: Taipei Times reported planned legislation for a Paraguay-Taiwan joint venture named Yguazu Digital to own a data center; Nearshore Americas reports initial 10MW capacity and expected operation by end-2027. Public sources describe it near/in Asuncion without a precise address.

name: Wilohosting Caaguazu data center
notes: Wilohosting's official blog and site state it operates its own physical data center in Caaguazu for hosting, VPS, and colocation; DC Hub also lists the facility as operational in Caaguazu.

name: Tigo Business Paraguay Asuncion / Fernando de la Mora data center
developer: Telecel S.A.E. / Tigo Business Paraguay / Millicom
notes: Tigo official page describes Paraguay's Tier III data center and certifications; Uptime Institute identifies Tigo Paraguay Asuncion DC with Tier III Design and Constructed Facility certification. Inflect places a TIGO facility in Fernando de la Mora, Department Central.

name: Centro Nacional de Computacion San Lorenzo / IX.py data center
developer: Centro Nacional de Computacion / Universidad Nacional de Asuncion
notes: Inflect lists the San Lorenzo data center with IX.py connectivity and colocation; DC Hub reports 3MW and operational status in San Lorenzo, Central.
